spice_model.name: EEA555
spice_model.subcircuit:
.subckt EEA555 GND TRIG OUT RESET CTRL THR DISCH VCC
* Approximate behavioral 555; latch modeled by hysteretic switch
RCTRL VCC CTRL 5k
RCTRL2 CTRL MID 5k
RCTRL3 MID GND 5k
BSET SET GND V=V(TRIG)<V(VCC)/3 ? V(VCC) : (V(THR)>2*V(VCC)/3 ? 0 : V(LATCH))
RL SET LATCH 1k
CL LATCH GND 1n IC=0
BOUT OUT GND V=V(RESET)<0.7 ? 0 : (V(LATCH)>V(VCC)/2 ? V(VCC)-0.2 : 0.1)
SD DISCH GND GND OUT DISCHSW
.model DISCHSW SW(Ron=10 Roff=1e9 Vt=-2.5 Vh=0.1)
.ends EEA555

spice_model.name: EEALM358
spice_model.subcircuit:
.subckt EEALM358 OUT1 INN1 INP1 VN INP2 INN2 OUT2 VP
* Behavioral LM358: 100 dB gain, 1 MHz GBW, 0.3 V/us slew, output between ground and VCC-1.5 V
BI1 VN P1 I=max(min(0.1*(v(INP1)-v(INN1)), 4.8m), -4.8m)
RP1 P1 VN 1Meg
CP1 P1 VN 15.9n
DH1 P1 VP DCLAMP
DL1 VN P1 DCLAMP
BO1 O1 VN V=max(min(v(P1,VN), v(VP,VN)-1.5), 0.005)
RO1 O1 OUT1 50
BI2 VN P2 I=max(min(0.1*(v(INP2)-v(INN2)), 4.8m), -4.8m)
RP2 P2 VN 1Meg
CP2 P2 VN 15.9n
DH2 P2 VP DCLAMP
DL2 VN P2 DCLAMP
BO2 O2 VN V=max(min(v(P2,VN), v(VP,VN)-1.5), 0.005)
RO2 O2 OUT2 50
.model DCLAMP D(Is=1e-14 N=1)
RQ VP VN 7k
.ends

NTC_10k_0805.typical_application: Temperature sensing: put it in a divider with a 10k fixed resistor; the midpoint voltage falls as temperature rises. R(T) = 10k * exp(3950 * (1/T - 1/298.15)). Simulates as its 25 C value unless value gives another resistance.
required_support_parts: 10k fixed resistor to form a divider

ESP32_C3_WROOM_02.typical_application: WiFi/BLE MCU on 3.3 V (feed from AMS1117_3V3). Put the antenna end at the board edge with no copper under it. EN needs 10k pull-up + 1uF to GND. IO9 low at reset enters download mode; IO18/IO19 are native USB D-/D+.
required_support_parts: 10k R pull-up on EN plus 1uF C from EN to GND
Button from IO9 to GND for download mode (optional)
